key_highlights: ASX futures point to early gains following a strong Wall Street session despite US tech volatility.
ANZ reports FY profit surging to $7.6b, but flags rising 90+ day home loan mortgage arrears.
Severe drop in crude oil prices dampens energy sector outlook, while iron ore holds fragile support.
Australian dollar weakens sharply, supporting offshore revenue earners but complicating RBA inflation mandate.
Credit and property stress intensify with a $3b Sydney builder collapse and record housing downturn.

sectors.trend: Resilient headline earnings contrasted against rising retail credit stress and commercial builder insolvencies.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX shows robust statutory profit but accelerating mortgage delinquencies, property downturns, and builder defaults will drive higher impairment provisioning across major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX).

sectors.trend: Severe crude price weakness and heightened domestic regulatory and ESG scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Depressed global oil benchmarks will pressure near-term earnings for WDS.AX and STO.AX, despite progress on domestic gas appraisal in the Beetaloo Basin.

sectors.trend: Iron ore prices stabilizing near support levels while gold and critical minerals exploration accelerate.
sectors.implications: AUD/USD depreciation offsets commodity price softness for tier-1 producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX), while gold explorers (NST.AX) benefit from strong bullion pricing.

sectors.trend: US tech volatility following Nvidia governance headwinds, alongside data centre power supply bottlenecks.
sectors.implications: Broader tech valuations face sentiment headwinds; infrastructure operators (NXT.AX) face heightened execution and power grid constraints.

sectors.trend: Household cash flow contraction driven by elevated RBA interest rates and debt-servicing burdens.
sectors.implications: Discretionary retail (WES.AX) faces volume pressure despite Black Friday discounting, while staple supermarkets (WOW.AX, COL.AX) retain defensive positioning.

key_themes: Divergence between resilient headline corporate profits and deteriorating household debt servicing capacity.
Commodity market split with weak energy prices weighed down by oil slumps versus currency-cushioned miners.
Elevated domestic macro headwinds including RBA restrictive policy, deep property downturn, and builder failures.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LTV domestic mortgage exposures; favor banks with diversified non-lending earnings and solid CET1 capital buffers.
Avoid tier-2/3 contractors; screen REITs and commercial lenders for direct exposure to distressed large builders.
Hedge energy exposure; rotate capital toward low-cost domestic gas infrastructure with long-term take-or-pay contracts.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent RBA Restrictive Policy & AUD Depreciation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize ASX exporters earning USD (healthcare, global mining) to capture FX tailwinds and insulate from domestic consumption headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate USD-earning diversified miners and gold producers.
opportunities.rationale: Weaker AUD/USD enhances local currency dividend yield and operating cash flows, mitigating bulk commodity softness.

opportunities.recommendation: Selectively buy quality healthcare and global defensive staples.
opportunities.rationale: High proportion of foreign revenue insulates earnings from Australian housing downturn and RBA rate drag.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to pure-play domestic lenders and leveraged REITs.
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating mortgage arrears and the deepest housing downturn on record elevate bad debt risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-beta energy producers vulnerable to global oil slide.
defensive_moves.rationale: Depressed global oil demand and weak benchmarks reduce free cash flow yields and dividend prospects.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound trading for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) between 8,050 and 8,350 as Wall Street momentum contends with domestic credit stress and soft energy markets.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued earnings growth for domestic cyclicals over 6–12 months, with capital rotation favoring offshore earners, infrastructure, and gold assets until RBA pivot.
key_catalysts: RBA upcoming monetary policy decision and updated inflation forecasts.
China stimulus implementation and bulk commodity demand data.
Australian bank half-year/full-year bad debt provisioning and mortgage delinquency reports.
Global crude oil production adjustments and geopolitical stabilization.
watch_list: AUD/USD currency level test of multi-month support
Dalian iron ore futures and Singapore crude benchmarks
Australian quarterly CPI and retail sales volumes
ASIC reports on construction sector counterparty credit risk
